title: 12 Best Graze on haggis rolls, artisan cheese toasties, and craft gin at Edinburgh's weekend food markets.
description: Explore Edinburgh's vibrant weekend food markets for the ultimate Scottish street food experience. Savor haggis rolls, gourmet cheese toasties, craft gin, and more.

places.name: Oink (Grassmarket Market Stall)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The 'Oink' Roll with haggis stuffing (if available at the market stall) or their classic hog roast roll with sage and onion stuffing.

places.name: I.J. Mellis Cheesemonger (Toastie Stall at Stockbridge Market)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The 'Isle of Mull Cheddar & Onion Chutney' toastie, or ask for their weekly special which often highlights a unique local cheese.

places.name: Edinburgh Gin Distillery (Market Pop-up)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A classic 'Edinburgh Gin Rhubarb & Ginger' G&T, or ask for a sample of their latest seasonal release.

places.name: Alanda's Fish & Chips (Market Stall)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Classic 'Haddock and Chips' with a sprinkle of salt and vinegar, or try their Scampi if available.

places.name: Bonnie Burrito (Market Van)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The 'Chipotle Chicken Burrito' with all the fixings, or the 'Black Bean & Sweet Potato Burrito' for a tasty veggie option.

places.name: The Crema Caravan (Coffee & Dessert Truck)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A portion of warm 'Churros with Chocolate Sauce' and a 'Flat White'.

places.name: Jarvis Pickle Kitchen (Pies & Sausage Rolls)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their classic 'Steak & Ale Pie' or the 'Mac 'n' Cheese Pie' for a modern twist.

places.name: Babu Bombay Street Food (Market Stall)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their 'Chicken Tikka Roll' or a portion of 'Vegetable Samosas' with a tangy chutney.

places.name: The Haggis Box (Grassmarket Market)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A 'Haggis Roll' with a dollop of whisky sauce for the full Scottish experience.

places.name: Barnett's Bakery (Market Stall)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A 'Cinnamon Swirl' or a slice of their 'Carrot Cake' to go with your market coffee, or a loaf of their sourdough.

places.name: Lochaber Farm Shop (Hot Food Stall at Edinburgh Farmers' Market)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their 'Beef Burger' with local cheese and a side of their own haggis bonbons if available.

places.name: Pizza Geeks (Market Van)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The 'Marvel' (Margherita) for a classic, or try their 'Haggis, Neeps & Tatties' special if you're feeling adventurous.
